name: cortex-viz-ui-tests
description: Test harness for the browser UI under ui/. NOTE: this package deliberately does NOT set "type": "module" — the UI ships as CommonJS-compatible script-tag JavaScript, and flipping the package type reinterprets every .js in the repo as ESM, which silently skips the UMD `module.exports` branch in ui/unified/js/spatial_hash.js and ui/brain/js/trigram.js and breaks the existing tests/js/run_trigram_conformance.mjs harness. Test files use .mjs explicitly instead.
